decision_gates.method: PASS only for exact auditor agreement on posterior, VOI, envelopes, rankings, model gates, UNKNOWN and route regret; all ineligible checks must remain unselectable.
decision_gates.in_set_hypothesis: Worst-case envelope-policy route regret must be strictly below point-model regret on the reversal case and equal on singleton/invariant cases; cost tolerance is exactly zero for those unchanged choices.
decision_gates.uncertain_ranking: Any overlap or reversal between per-check fixed-measure VOI intervals returns UNCERTAIN_MODEL_DEPENDENT_RANKING and invokes only the separately named minimax-regret fallback.
decision_gates.outside_set: Truth outside the finite credal set is an explicit limitation probe; it is not counted toward the in-set hypothesis gate.

fallback_rule: Among no_check and admissible checks, minimize maximum regret over the finite credal model set; tie-break by lower acquisition cost, then lexical check id. This is not the fixed-measure envelope and is not labeled Gamma-maximin VOI.

construction_preflight.classification: unfrozen implementation/auditor development output; not a formal T0 outcome

scope: CPU-only deterministic finite simulator; no live likelihood calibration, GUI, user data, runtime policy, authorization or safety claim.
